reason: I already do one big shop a week in Jbeil and fill the boot, so a daily service doesn't fit how I buy. I'd still have to go and collect it at their hour, not mine, so I'd save little.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine, and I only have their word that I'm paying the till price.
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery to my door, or a pickup point on my own street with a wider window, plus receipts shown for every bag.
